name: The Whispering Woods
description: A mystical forest shrouded in an eerie silence. The trees seem to watch your every move.

start.description: You are at the edge of the woods, where sunlight still reaches. A path leads deeper into the gloom to the north.

ancient_oak.description: You stand before a massive, gnarled oak tree that seems to hum with an ancient energy. A strange inscription is carved into its bark. A path leads south back to the entrance, and another path leads east into a clearing.

gloomy_clearing.description: You are in a small clearing where the trees are thin, revealing a star-filled sky. A faint whisper can be heard on the wind. The only exit is to the west, back to the ancient oak.

whispers_of_the_woods.name: The Whispers of the Woods
whispers_of_the_woods.description: Decipher the inscription on the Ancient Oak to understand the whispers in the clearing.
steps: Read the inscription on the Ancient Oak.
Listen to the whispers in the Gloomy Clearing.
